goal: Use the binding-identifiability audit to make one causal architecture change instead of iterating routers.
decision: Introduce a dual-view interface: semantic token late interaction handles edge identity; frozen structured graph handles relation reasoning. Factor parent-vs-specialist activation away from edge identity.

architecture.binding: final-layer query-to-field MaxSim; edge score is symmetric source/target mean
architecture.reasoning: existing relation-conditioned multi-layer query + frozen dual-endpoint graph parent

method_lessons: Measure information survival stage-by-stage before adding routing complexity.
Keep fine-grained semantic binding separate from query-agnostic structured compression when the latter destroys relevance geometry.
Do not hard-code the DEV-best layer when the capability is robust across the representation stack.
Separate abstention from expert/edge identity when experiments show those subproblems have different difficulty.
